documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Management reported strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust pre-sales growth and expanding profitability. Pre-sales for H1 FY27 reached INR879 crores, while total revenue and EBITDA also saw significant year-on-year increases. The company added three new projects during the quarter, expanding its overall GDV pipeline, and plans four more project launches in H2 FY27. Management remains confident in meeting its full-year guidance for pre-sales, revenue growth, and profit margins. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported robust financial and operational performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, driven by strong pre-sales growth in the Mumbai luxury real estate segment.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR1,800 crores and INR2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA and PAT margins to be 35% to 40% and 25% to 30% respectively for FY27.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining strong profitability, with EBITDA and PAT margin expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of achieving pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels for FY27.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering our stated guidance for FY27 of a pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: Management remains committed to its FY27 guidance of pre-sales ranging from INR1,800 to 2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

demand_outlook.claim: Mumbai housing sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 reached their highest level since 2018, led by the luxury segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai remains India’s largest housing market, with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018, and the luxury segment continues to lead.

demand_outlook.claim: Prime residential prices in Mumbai rose 6.2% year-on-year in the first half of the calendar year.
demand_outlook.quote: In the first half of the calendar year, sales of homes priced above INR10 crores reached a record of over INR18,500 crores, while prime residential prices rose 6.2% year-on-year, more than twice the global average.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is primarily driven by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is driven largely by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations, while scarce land in prime micromarkets makes redevelopment the principal route to new supply, precisely where Lotus has built its capability.

demand_outlook.claim: Management does not expect the recent RBI repo rate hike to materially alter demand in their operating micromarkets because luxury buyers rely less on home loans.
demand_outlook.quote: Our buyers rely far less on home loans and buy for long-term value and lifestyle. We, therefore, do not expect it to materially alter demand in the micromarkets we operate in.

demand_outlook.claim: The GIFT City project indicates strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, alongside high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is spread across the portfolio rather than resting on a single project.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2 FY27 pre-sales grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs, with six projects contributing, which shows that demand is spread across the portfolio rather than resting on a single project.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand across Mumbai has grown by more than 11%.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai is a good example of this. Even as the overall housing market has moderated, luxury housing demand across the city has grown by more than 11%, led by successful families and professionals upgrading to bigger, better homes.

demand_outlook.claim: Supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remains constrained with very little fresh land left.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remain constrained. There is very little fresh land left, so most new luxury supply comes through redevelopment, rather than greenfield construction.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury buyers are driven by long-term wealth creation, family legacy, and lifestyle, not by loan rates.
demand_outlook.quote: While most buyers globally are being cautious, given interest rates and broader uncertainty, luxury buyers are not. They are driven by long-term wealth creation, family legacy, and lifestyle, not by loan rates.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added three new projects during the quarter: Lotus Impressa, Lotus Stellar, and Lotus Supremus.
capex_expansion.quote: Three new projects added, Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park in Dadar West, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu, which adds INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores of GDV to existing GDV pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch four projects in the second half with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are well-prepared for the second half. We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects adding INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.
capex_expansion.quote: We also made significant progress on business development during the quarter, where company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects: Lotus Supremus (Juhu), Lotus Empressa (Shivaji Park, Dadar West), Lotus Stellar (Versova) and additional area secured for Lotus Insignia which together adds INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.

capex_expansion.claim: The GIFT City mixed-use flagship ultra-luxury project has an expected commencement in Q1 FY28 and completion timeline in FY31 with an estimated GDV of INR 2,000-2,200 Crs.
capex_expansion.quote:
Completion Timeline: FY31
❖ Expected Commencement: Q1 FY28
❖ Estimated GDV: INR 2,000-2,200 Crs

capex_expansion.claim: Four launches are planned for the second half with a combined estimated GDV of approximately INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.
capex_expansion.quote: As we enter the second half, we are well prepared. Four launches are planned, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia with a combined estimated GDV of ~INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed developer for a commercial redevelopment project with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores in Juhu.
capex_expansion.quote: We were also recently appointed developer for a very, very prestigious commercial redevelopment project with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores in Juhu.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Our ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects, 17 residential and 5 commercial, with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores with margins expanding to 39.9%.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% year-on-year to INR269 crores. EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores, with margins expanding to 39.9%.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 PAT margin improved to 33.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For the first half, revenue stood at INR401 crores, up 69%, EBITDA at INR155 crores, up 95%, and PAT at INR134 crores, up 86% at an improved PAT margin of 33.5%.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin remains around 25%-30% on a consistent basis.
margins_costs.quote:
PAT Margin (%)
~ 25%-30%
on a consistent basis

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores at a PAT margin of 34.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores, growing 63% year-on-year with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4%.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieves 10% to 15% higher pricing than other developers in its micro-market.
margins_costs.quote: Sanjay Jain: So, regarding the pricing related to other developers, so normally in our micro-market we are getting 10% to 15% higher than the other developers.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With these additions, our ongoing and upcoming pipeline now comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales stood at INR409 crores, up by 567% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Pre-sales stood at INR409 crores, up by 567% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The average selling price stood at INR86,000 per square foot.
orders_capacity.quote: Our average selling price stood at INR86,000 per square foot, underscoring the strength of our product across the micro-markets we operate in.

capital_allocation.claim: As of September 30, 2026, the company had a net cash position of INR494 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 30th September 2026, we had a net cash position of INR494 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised approximately INR792 crores through a fresh IPO issue with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of our IPO, with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores after issue expenses, of which INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary for the Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the IPO proceeds, INR305 crores had been deployed as on September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: INR305 crores had been deployed as on 30th September 2026. We remain on track with our planned utilization schedule.

capital_allocation.claim: Fresh issue proceeds from the IPO were utilized for investment in subsidiaries for part-funding development and construction costs of ongoing projects.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment in our Subsidiaries, Richfeel Real Estate Private Limited, Dhyan Projects Private Limited and Tryksha Real Estate Private Limited for part-funding development and construction cost of our Ongoing Projects, Amalfi, The Arcadian and Varun, respectively amounting to ~INR 550 Crs.

capital_allocation.claim: Total cash balance stood at approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores as of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of INR550 crores earmarked for the subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, INR271 crores has been deployed as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Of the INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, we have deployed INR271 crores as on 30th June 2026, and the utilization remains in line with our planned deployment schedule.

management_commitments.quote: We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to collect around INR1,000 crores in cash collections this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So, this year we are intend to collect around INR1,000 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects RCC work for the Varun project to be completed before January and 90% of the work completed till March.
management_commitments.quote: Now, we have around 20 slabs, so we are confident before January we'll complete the RCC work and 90% of the work will be completed till March.
